% -------------------------------------------------------------------
% CHAPTER / SECTION TITLE FORMAT & SPACING
% -------------------------------------------------------------------
% Pull chapter title close to top margin (before=-20pt = subtract 20pt)
\titleformat{\chapter}[block]
  {\normalfont\large\bfseries\centering}
  {\MakeUppercase{\chaptertitlename}\ \thechapter}{1em}{\large\MakeUppercase}
\titlespacing*{\chapter}{0pt}{-20pt}{16pt}

% Section: left-aligned, bold
\titleformat{\section}[block]
  {\normalfont\normalsize\bfseries}{\thesection}{1em}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{10pt}{6pt}

% Subsection
\titleformat{\subsection}[block]
  {\normalfont\normalsize\bfseries\itshape}{\thesubsection}{1em}{}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{8pt}{4pt}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------
% PAGE STYLES
% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\setlength{\headheight}{18pt}

% Front-matter style: no header rule, roman page number at footer centre
\fancypagestyle{frontmatter}{%
  \fancyhf{}
  \fancyfoot[C]{\small Trang \thepage}
  \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
  \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}
}

% Main-matter style: thin header rule, page number at right of header
\fancypagestyle{mainmatter}{%
  \fancyhf{}
  \fancyhead[R]{\small\thepage}
  \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
  \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}
}

%  PAGE BORDER MACRO
% ============================================================
\newcommand{\coverborder}{%
\begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture,overlay]
\draw[line width=0.8pt]
  (current page text area.north west) rectangle (current page text area.south east);
\draw[line width=2.8pt]
  ($(current page text area.north west)+(0.15cm,-0.15cm)$)
  rectangle
  ($(current page text area.south east)+(-0.15cm,0.15cm)$);
\end{tikzpicture}%
}

% ============================================================
%  HELPER MACROS
% ============================================================

% Figure insertion macro.
% When the image file is missing, shows a grey rule box (placeholder).
% NOTE: do NOT use \texttt{#2} in the fallback -- image paths often
%       contain underscores (_) which crash LaTeX in text mode.
%
% Usage:  \insertfigure{width_ratio}{path/to/image}{Caption text}{label}
% Example:\insertfigure{0.8}{Pictures/erd}{ER Diagram}{erd}
\newcommand{\insertfigure}[4]{%
  \begin{figure}[H]\centering%
  \IfFileExists{#2}%
    {\includegraphics[width=#1\textwidth]{#2}}%
    {\rule{#1\textwidth}{4cm}}%  <-- simple grey box, no special chars
  \caption{#3}\label{fig:#4}%
  \end{figure}%
}
